Overall verdict: **needs_changes**. The implementer correctly declared `{Repo: DontPanic, Env: dev, Project: (none)}`; its command log contains no forbidden or missing-required-flag shapes. The required historical-failure, corrected-text, live-README, and registry-helper assertions passed manually; Ruff lint and formatting passed. Pytest could not initialize because the read-only audit environment has no writable temporary directory.

FINDING (high, correctness): Disclaimer attribution still permits false negatives in README-style prose. Evidence: both `Gemini is a shipped executor (Grok is operator-only).` and `Shipped executors — Gemini — Grok is operator-only.` returned zero violations. `_segment_class` lets any disclaimer override a claim in the same segment, while `_mention_excused` excuses a neutral mention when a disclaimer exists on either side—even when the other side is its executor claim. Recommendation: associate each agent mention deterministically with its own claim/disclaimer, handle parentheticals and label/apposition layouts, and add both probes as regressions.
